tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the sidebar. Dark: pure black, the Apple Developer site's --fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped panels. Dark: #1D1D1F, Apple Developer --fill-tertiary (global nav, tables, cards).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Callouts, code blocks and the card tray. Dark: #161617, Apple Developer --fill-secondary.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Search field, icon wells, hover rows, skeletons. Dark: #333336, Apple Developer --fill-gray-quaternary.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, neutral badge ground, progress track. Dark: #424245, Apple Developer --fill-gray-tertiary.

tokens.name: control-selected
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a SegmentedControl on a fill track. Dark: #6E6E73 (Apple --fill-gray-secondary); white text 5.1:1.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, popovers, drawers. Dark: #1D1D1F with the popover hairline so it separates from cards.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text field, text area and select backgrounds. Dark: #161617, an inset on #1D1D1F overlays.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a Dialog or Drawer.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Environment strip above the app. Dark: #1D1D1F, the Apple global-nav fill.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines. Dark: #333336.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Button and input outlines, empty-state dashes; decorative (below 3:1). Dark: #424245, Apple's border colour.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Checkbox, radio and switch-off outlines, field hover. 3:1+ on surface, surface-raised and surface-overlay in both themes (dark #6E6E73: 3.3:1 on #1D1D1F).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, values. Dark: #F5F5F7, Apple's primary glyph gray. On every surface and fill.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Body copy, nav labels, table cells. Dark matches ink (#F5F5F7), as on the Apple Developer site.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Descriptions, comparison lines, labels. Dark: #A1A1A6 (Apple glyph-gray-secondary-alt), 4.9:1 on fill.

tokens.name: ink-subdued
tokens.usage: Timestamps and axis labels on surface, surface-raised and surface-muted only. Dark: #86868B (Apple glyph-gray-secondary).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholder glyphs. Dark: #6E6E73 (Apple glyph-gray-tertiary). Not for readable text.

tokens.name: ink-on-banner
tokens.usage: Text on banner.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected-tab bar, active indicators, switch on. Dark: #0071E3, Apple's button blue (white 4.7:1).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of accent fills. Dark: #0076DF, Apple's button hover.

tokens.name: ink-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on accent (6.2:1 light, 5.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, active nav label, settings titles. Dark: #2997FF, Apple's link blue (5.6:1 on #1D1D1F, 4.2:1 on fill: avoid links on fill).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent badge ground and selected rows; accent-text reads on it (dark #162B5B, Apple --fill-blue-secondary, 4.6:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset. Dark: #0071E3, Apple's focus colour (3.6:1 on #1D1D1F, 4.5:1 on black).

tokens.name: toast
tokens.usage: Toast and tooltip ground. Dark: #333336.

tokens.name: ink-on-toast
tokens.usage: Toast message text.

tokens.name: toast-action
tokens.usage: Toast action link. Dark: #7DC1FF (Apple light-blue figure), 6.6:1 on toast.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary series line (gross volume, new customers) and the Available legend dot.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series; Open invoices.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series; Paid invoices.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series; overdue buckets.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series; Void.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: AI content marker only (sparkle, AIResponse hairline). Dark: #A95ED2, Apple purple figure.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Incoming balance segment, empty bars, the dashed not-yet-happened part of an intraday line.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and baselines.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Succeeded / Paid text and icons. Dark: #03A10E (Apple green), 4.5:1 on success-soft, 4.9:1 on #1D1D1F.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge/alert ground. Dark: #002B03.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed / error text and icons, danger button fill. Dark: #FF3037 (Apple red).

tokens.name: ink-on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (6.2:1 light, 5.7:1 dark: black on Apple red).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge/alert ground. Dark: #330000.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Overdue / attention text and icons. Dark: #F56300 (Apple orange).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge/alert ground. Dark: #290D00.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational text and icons. Dark: #2997FF.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badge/alert ground. Dark: #002A51.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per page, top left, followed by a separator rule or the action row.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: The headline number of a balance or hero chart. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Value in a MetricCard. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Card titles, table headers, emphasised values.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Settle and pay out funds in CAD, EUR, or GBP.
styles.usage: Default text: nav items, descriptions, table cells.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels, in ink-muted. Sentence case, never all caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges; legend dot gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, gap between stacked label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item horizontal padding, button padding (x).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card gutters in the overview grid; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: MetricCard padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; gap between page title and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; settings grid column gap.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Main content left inset from the sidebar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, icon wells, tab indicator ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav item hover.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Metric cards, callouts, the No data pill.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels (recommendations) and the dashboard tray.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Search field ends, the setup-progress ring, avatar.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating cards on white. Dark relies on surface steps, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, the developer drawer.

zIndex.note: Stacking order for overlays; higher sits on top.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the top bar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and tooltips.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawer and the Ask AI panel with its scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always above dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Default button, select and segmented control height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, search field, md buttons, nav rows.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in sign-in and pairing screens.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: App sidebar.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Drawer and Ask AI panel.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: Default Dialog width; 640px for forms with two columns.

tokens.name: banner-height
tokens.usage: Environment strip. Counts toward the chrome budget.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar with search and actions. Banner + top bar stay at or under 96px (12.5% of a 768px-tall window).

tokens.name: content-max-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content inside the main column.

tokens.name: fold-reference
tokens.usage: Reference window height for the above-the-fold check (1366x768 desktop); also check 390x844 phone.
